definitions.explanation: A person who has accomplished great things and is remembered for their achievements. Often used in educational contexts when discussing notable historical figures. Composed of 偉 (great, admirable) + 人 (person).

examples.japanese: {偉人|いじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝記|でんき}→伝記：04069_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a biography of a great person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧{偉人|いじん}たち⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There is much to learn from the great figures who left their mark on history.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{偉人|いじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あこがれて⟦{科学者|かがくしゃ}→科学者：19378_kagakusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I admired great people and wanted to become a scientist.

notes:
USAGE:
{偉人|いじん} is commonly used in educational contexts — children's books, school assignments, and TV programs often feature {偉人|いじん}{伝|でん} (biographies of great people). The word has a respectful, somewhat formal tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偉人|いじん}{伝|でん} (biography of a great person)
- ⟦{歴史上|れきしじょう}→歴史上：24044_rekishijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{偉人|いじん} (great historical figure)
- {偉人|いじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名言|めいげん}→名言：20185_meigen⟧ (famous quotes from great people)
- {偉人|いじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ (to learn from great figures)
